<!-- If the current guidance creates an immediate exploitable risk, follow SECURITY.md and report it privately. -->

## Content location

Link to the public page and identify the relevant heading or item.

## Problem

What is inaccurate, stale, unclear, unsafe, or missing? Explain who could be
affected.

## Proposed correction

Provide concise replacement wording or the outcome the revised content should
achieve.

## Sources

Link to primary documentation, standards, advisories, incident disclosures, or
other authoritative evidence. Separate confirmed facts from interpretation.

## Review sensitivity

- [ ] Time-sensitive product/version claim
- [ ] Incident or loss claim
- [ ] Legal/compliance claim
- [ ] High-risk security procedure
- [ ] Vendor/tool recommendation or affiliation
- [ ] General clarity or accessibility
